name: Patient crowded-short hold: deep-negative funding, long horizon, wide stops (NOT a tight-stop scalp)
rationale: Thesis: short squeezes off a deep-negative-funding extreme are a multi-week REGIME, not a one-day pop — the bottoming process is noisy and a tight stop gets shaken out before the squeeze pays. Take the crowded-short positioning entry but hold patiently with wide stops and a long time-stop, riding the full recovery. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.006,-0.0005] (crowded shorts). Exit only on a wide stop, a large profit target, a long time-stop, or funding fully normalizing positive (cross_up) — i.e. the squeeze is unambiguously complete. DISCONFIRMER: must beat the SAME entry with a short max-hold and a tight stop (the scalp variant) — if the fast scalp matches net Sharpe net of fees, the patient structure adds nothing and the edge (if any) is a one-day reaction, not a regime. funding_feature null — positioning level, not carry. Low turnover by construction.
catalyst: deep-negative funding (crowded shorts) opening a multi-week squeeze recovery
